dedupe_keys.name: a cyber resilient framework for detection and identification of false data injection attacks in pv plants

description: The model combines equality-constrained weighted least squares for gross anomalies with an equality-constrained Schweppe-Huber estimator for subtle measurement manipulation in photovoltaic plants. Plant topology informs estimator settings. The source reports experimental F1 scores above 85 percent in its low-generation and coordinated measurement scenarios; this is study-specific evidence and does not establish universal detection. This plant-level estimator is distinct from the MbPA and EC-WLSE energy-community dataset procedure. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Public access and the deposit document licence do not establish executable access, software reuse rights or operating costs. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results.
name: A Cyber-Resilient Framework for Detection and Identification of False Data Injection Attacks in PV Plants
